visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Static Nested Class for a Helper That Needs No Outer State
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The Helper class does not use any field of Main, yet it is an inner class that needs an outer object. Make it a static nested class. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: A non-static inner class silently keeps a reference to its outer object, which costs memory and can keep that object alive. A static nested class is just a class that lives inside another one's namespace.
